name: space force

events.event: US Space Force confirmed on Monday that the US has deployed weapons into orbit.
variants: 武器数量表述簇内不一：1005077:1 为单数『a space weapon』，1001691:1 / 1002427:1 / 1002160:1 / 1009708:1 均为复数『weapons』。确认主体的说法也有粗细之分：多数文章为 US Space Force，1009708:1 记作『the US military』。清单取复数 + Space Force，与多数口径一致。

events.event: US Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink announced on Monday that the US now had 'on-orbit space control weapons' capable of defending American forces against hostile action.
variants: 同一句『on-orbit space control weapons capable of defending the Joint Force against hostile adversary action』在簇内有两个归属口径：1007986:2/:4 与 1009708:2 归给空军部长 Troy Meink 本人；1001691:2、1002427:2、1002160:2 则归给『a US Space Force spokesperson』的书面声明。清单锁死 Meink 这一口径。

清单把'on-orbit space control weapons capable of defending... against hostile action/adversary action'这句话的说出者写成 Troy Meink 本人，与 1007986:2/4、1005077:2、1009708:2 一致；但几乎相同的措辞（'defending the Joint Force against hostile adversary action'）在 1002160:2、1002427:2、1001691:2 里被明确归为'a (Space Force) spokesperson said in a statement'，未提 Meink 姓名。同一句话在簇内被分别归给具名官员和匿名发言人，是施事口径冲突。

events.event: US Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink said revealing more about the capability would undermine its deterrent value.

caveat: 基准从原文独立抽,未经人工核。glm-flash 的抽取质量没有独立验过 —— 覆盖率的绝对值据此打折读,臂间相对比较不受影响(各臂共用同一份)。

impurityFilter.note: 后置过滤:整条出处都是杂质文章的事件删除,幸存事件里的杂质 articleId 剔除后重算 nArticles/nSources 与分层。事件措辞未重抽。
